title: Oil Rubbed Bronze Toilet Paper Stand, 29-Inch Freestanding Euro Style Holder - Carolina Collection, Allied Brass
description:
Keep toilet paper within easy reach when wall space is limited, without drilling into tile in Oil Rubbed Bronze, which offers rich, dark brown tones with subtle copper highlights, bringing Old World character to any bathroom. This freestanding toilet paper stand is crafted from solid brass and uses a heavy base to help prevent tipping, giving your bathroom a stable, classic solution.

- Freestanding design places tissue where you need it most
- European-style hook makes roll changes quick and easy
- Heavy base helps keep the stand secure from tipping
- Traditional look that complements classic bath accessories
- Limited lifetime warranty for long-term confidence

Specs: Overall size 8 in L x 27 in H x 6 in W. Material: brass. Mounting: freestanding (no wall mounting). Assembly required: yes. Included: toilet tissue stand. Warranty: limited lifetime. Shipping weight: 5.6 lbs.
